description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans reminders functionality using Azure Cosmos DB as the backing store. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify reminder behaviors such as start, stop, restart, multiple reminders, and failure scenarios, specifically for Cosmos DB integration.
